subject: Confirming technical deep-dive: timeline, owners, calendar pin
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Santos <alex.santos@luminex.ai>, Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@luminex.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + proposal: 60–90m technical deep-dive

Thanks again for the conversation this morning — good to learn more about Luminex's inference targets and where you're seeing the biggest friction. Quick recap from our side:

- Primary use case: low-latency document understanding at scale (175–350 tokens typical, spikes to 1k).
- Key constraints: strict data residency (US-only), predictable 99p latency, and integration with your current S3 pipeline.
- Outcomes you asked for: throughput/cost estimates, model-variant fallback behavior, and an ops runbook for production rollouts.

Next step we propose: 60–90 minute technical deep-dive with our ML infra + solutions engineers to walk architecture, perf expectations, and a short runbook prototype. Availability windows (PT):
- Option A: Tue 2026-09-08 10:00–11:30 PT
- Option B: Wed 2026-09-09 13:00–14:30 PT
- Option C: Thu 2026-09-10 09:00–10:30 PT

Proposed agenda (high-level):
1) 10–15m: goals & success criteria (your side)
2) 25–35m: infra walkthrough — runtime, routing, caching strategies
3) 20–25m: perf/cost estimates + quantization options
4) 10–15m: next steps & mutual action plan

I attached a one-pager with what we'll prepare and a short checklist for attendees. Can you confirm which window works and the names/titles of people who should join from your side (especially SRE/security)? If Priya from security can join, great — copying Priya here.

Thanks — I can follow up with a calendar invite once we pick a slot.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference]

Attachments:
- tdx-prep-one-pager.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
From: Alex Santos <alex.santos@luminex.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-09-01T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposal: 60–90m technical deep-dive

Hi Hannah — thanks for the clear recap. Both Priya and I can make a session; Priya will cover our security questions. Our rough availability (PT):
- Preferred: Tue 2026-09-08 10:00–11:30 PT
- Backup: Thu 2026-09-10 09:00–10:30 PT

Attendees from Luminex we plan to include:
- Alex Santos — Head of Product (I'll lead the use-case walkthrough)
- Priya Kapoor — Security Lead (security/compliance Qs)
- Daniel Park — SRE (ops/runbook)
- Maya Chen — ML Eng (integration details)

A couple of asks so your team can prepare:
- Can you include any brief perf numbers for the 2–3 model sizes you'll propose?
- We're particularly interested in how Redwood handles KV cache warmup during cold starts.

I'll hold the A slot for now; please send an invite and any prep links.

—Alex
